text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, mesna 100 mg/mL 10 mL multidose vials are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 73 units with daily use of 3.3, providing 22 days on hand. Corvale General holds 43 units with daily use of 2.7, providing 16 days on hand. The current product label identifies Hikma Farmacêutica (Portugal) as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show mesna is not listed on the shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 16 to 22 days at present usage rates. No FDA shortage designation exists. Supply continuity depends on securing additional stock before current supply is exhausted.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Sagent Pharmaceuticals, Bamboo US Bidco LCC, Baxter Healthcare Company, Eugia US LLC, and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to confirm manufacturing site information for each alternative supplier; requires Quality Assurance approval.
3. Buyer to establish safety stock targets for both campuses; requires Pharmacy Director and CFO approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose modifications at this time.
